Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 10

“Freed from passion, fear, and anger, absorbed in me and taking refuge in me, purified by the austerity of knowledge, many have attained my being.”

Many have attained matters here. Krishna cites precedent rather than promise, and calls knowledge a tapas — an austerity, something undergone rather than simply acquired.
